We can answer: earliest references are in the Jewish historian Flavius Josephus (Antiquities of the Jews, Book 18, 3) and the Roman historian Tacitus (Annals, 15.44). Also the earliest Christian references are the letters of Paul (e.g., 1 Thessalonians 2:14-16, 1 Corinthians 15:3-4). But the question: earliest reference from historical record.
